original.statement: The v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema no longer allows "v1" for spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion, so resources setting it are rejected.

decision.reason: The CRD bundles [ev-9889c9b8706d] and [ev-e08924afdc47] show spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion in the external-secrets.io v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema of both releases, and the validator confirms its enum lost "v1" with nothing added. Removing an accepted value is validation-tightened, and before "v1" / after null match the computed diff (removed ["v1"], added []).
